title: SEIKO BELL MATIC WATCH
findings: Seiko Bell-Matic alarm automatic, dial reads SEIKO / BELL-MATIC / 17 JEWELS, day-date (TUE) window, linen textured silver dial with alarm ring, stainless case, two crowns. Circa early 1970s (likely 4006 calibre family). Title supported.
condition: Dial badly flaked and spotted around chapter ring and several indices, crystal scratched, case worn, aftermarket croc-print leather strap. Running state unknown.
reason: Genuine vintage Seiko Bell-Matic, collectable model with steady demand even with a tired dial.

interest.note: Vintage Seiko Bell-Matic 17J automatic alarm day-date, dial flaking.

title: VINTAGE DONKEY KONG JR GAME
findings: Nintendo Game & Watch Donkey Kong Jr. (new wide screen style green faceplate, 1982), front reads GAME & WATCH, DONKEY KONG JR., Nintendo, GAME A, GAME B, TIME, ALARM, ACL, JUMP, CONTROL. Original handheld, not a reproduction as far as can be seen.
condition: Faceplate scratched and worn, screen visible with some mottling, back and battery cover not shown, working state unknown.
reason: Original Nintendo Game & Watch handheld with an active retro gaming collector market.
marks_read: Nintendo GAME & WATCH DONKEY KONG JR.
